bio.text: Adrian Boafo, a Democrat, has represented District 23 (Prince George's County) in the Maryland House of Delegates since January 11, 2023, and has been listed as Assistant Majority Leader since 2024.
He is a candidate for Maryland's 5th Congressional District in 2026.
He was a member of the Bowie City Council and Mayor Pro Tem from 2019 to 2022, and earlier was national press assistant to Rep. Ruben Kihuen and campaign manager for Hoyer for Congress.
He was born in Arlington, Virginia, holds a B.A. from the University of Baltimore and an M.B.A. from American University, and is a government affairs executive at Oracle.
